theme._purpose: Complete token surface — agent resolves all theme access here
theme.rule: NEVER extend MaterialTheme. FinsibleTheme wraps it. Tokens via FinsibleTheme.{semantic|spacing|stroke|elevation|typography} CompositionLocal only.

tokenLayer.layer1: FinsiblePrimitives — raw color ramp (Green, Neutral, Red, Amber, Teal, Blue). Never referenced by components.
tokenLayer.layer2: FinsibleSemanticColors, FinsibleSpacing, FinsibleStroke, FinsibleElevation, FinsibleTypes — semantic design tokens. Accessed via FinsibleTheme.{semantic|spacing|stroke|elevation|typography}.
tokenLayer.layer3: Component-specific token classes (e.g. FinsibleButtonColors) — resolved in Defaults files from Layer 2.

compositionLocals._note: All private — only accessed via FinsibleTheme object properties below

FinsibleTheme.semantic.note: Layer 2 semantic color tokens — surfaces, content, brand, borders, feedback, transaction

FinsibleTheme.stroke.note: Width: hairline(0.5), thin(1), semiBold(1.5), bold(2), heavy(3)

FinsibleTheme.elevation.note: Light: shadows; Dark: surface tints. flat/raised/floating/modal/focus

FinsibleTheme.resolveColor.note: string-keyed dynamic lookup — accepts semantic names + legacy aliases + hex

FinsibleTheme.Dp.adaptedDp().note: scales arbitrary Dp value to current device via FinsibleUiScaler

FinsibleTheme.sizes.note: touch.{size}, icon.{size}, avatar.{size} — scaled by FinsibleUiScaler

colorTokens._note: Layer 2 — FinsibleSemanticColors. Access via FinsibleTheme.semantic.{name}. Legacy aliases (e.g. 'primaryBackground'→surfaceBase) exist in FinsibleColorResolver for backward compat.

colorTokens.surfaceRaised: raised card/sheet surface — n0 light / 0xFF232328 dark
colorTokens.surfaceOverlay: modal overlay surface — n0 light / 0xFF1C1C20 dark
colorTokens.surfaceBrandSubtle: brand-tinted subtle surface — Green.g50 light / 0xFF0E2318 dark
colorTokens.inputSurface: pre-split input background — surfaceSunken, may diverge
colorTokens.cardSurface: pre-split card background — surfaceRaised, may diverge
colorTokens.contentOnBrand: text/icons on brand backgrounds — n0 light / 0xFF101013 dark
colorTokens.iconPrimary: primary icon tint — n700 light / 0xFFEAEAED dark
colorTokens.iconSecondary: secondary icon tint — n600 light / 0xFFA4A4AE dark
colorTokens.iconTertiary: tertiary icon tint — n500 light / 0xFF78788A dark
colorTokens.iconDisabled: disabled icon tint — n400 light / 0xFF585864 dark
colorTokens.iconOnBrand: icon on brand — n0 light / 0xFF101013 dark
colorTokens.brandInteractive: primary interactive brand — Green.g600 light / 0xFF34A064 dark
colorTokens.brandInteractiveHovered: hovered interactive brand — Green.g700 light / 0xFF3DB870 dark
colorTokens.brandInteractivePressed: pressed interactive brand — Green.g800 light / 0xFF50CC88 dark
colorTokens.brandTint: brand tint fill — Green.g100 light / 0xFF142E22 dark
colorTokens.brandSubtle: brand subtle fill — Green.g50 light / 0xFF0E2318 dark
colorTokens.inputBorder: pre-split input border — borderDefault, may diverge
colorTokens.cardBorder: pre-split card border — borderDefault, may diverge

typographyTokens._note: Semantic role-based typography from FinsibleTypes. Scaled per device via FinsibleUiScaler. Access via FinsibleTheme.typography.{role}.
typographyTokens.caption: 11sp/15sp — timestamps, helper text

spacingTokens._note: Layer 2 — FinsibleSpacing. Access via FinsibleTheme.spacing.{role}. Scaled per device via FinsibleUiScaler.

strokeTokens._note: Layer 2 — FinsibleStroke. Access via FinsibleTheme.stroke.{name}. Scaled per device via FinsibleUiScaler.

elevationTokens._note: Layer 2 — FinsibleElevation + FinsibleShadowSpec. Access via FinsibleTheme.elevation.{name}. Light: shadows via Modifier.finsibleShadow(); Dark: surface tints only (shadow specs→None).
elevationTokens.raisedShadow: FinsibleShadowSpec(color=0x12000000, offsetY=FinsibleSpacing.stackMicro, blur=FinsibleRadius.xs) — raised cards (light) / None (dark)
elevationTokens.floatingShadow: FinsibleShadowSpec(color=0x1A000000, offsetY=FinsibleSpacing.stackXs, blur=FinsibleRadius.md) — floating elements (light) / None (dark)
elevationTokens.focusShadow: FinsibleShadowSpec(color=brand green with alpha, offset/blur=0dp) — focus ring (both themes)

radiusTokens._note: FinsibleRadius — component-level radius assignments. Access via FinsibleRadius.{name} or FinsibleRadius.Component.{name}.

sizeTokens._note: FinsibleSizes — touch targets, icons, avatars. Access via FinsibleSizes.{category}.{name}.

rules._purpose: Architectural invariants the agent must enforce — checked before any code generation

no-material-theme-extension.rule: Never extend MaterialTheme. FinsibleTheme wraps it.

composition-local-only.rule: Tokens via CompositionLocal / FinsibleTheme object only — never pass tokens as params.

no-preview-in-main.rule: @Preview only in preview/ package — never in component/ or default/.

playground-debug-only.rule: Playground files live in debug source set only — never main.

immutable-collections-in-state.rule: All StateFlow<T> where T contains collections must use ImmutableList/ImmutableMap.

io-dispatcher-for-db.rule: DB/network calls inside withContext(Dispatchers.IO). State updates on Main.

gate-before-write.rule: No file writes without /approve. All writes staged via gate extension.

architecture-data-flow.rule: Offline-first: ViewModel → LocalRepository (ObjectBox) → pending ops queue → SyncManager/EntitySyncHandler → Retrofit ApiService. Reads flow through Repository + CacheManager auto-cache. ViewModels only write through LocalRepositories; Repository layer is read-only for GET/caching. Local creates use negative IDs from LocalIdGenerator; handlers remap IDs after server create. ResponseHandlingConverterFactory + CacheManager must route BaseResponse.cache payloads into LocalRepository.addAll. Startup: FinsibleApp → IntegrityResolverService + ScopeManager → PostAuthInitializer + DataFetcher/IntegrityChecker.

source-set-boundaries.rule: Shared impl in main/. Debug-only in debug/. Release-only in release/. Mirror package/class paths across variants. Keep variant code thin; push reusable logic into main. No shared production logic in variant source sets.

ownership-map.rule: ui/navigation/** → route graph + transitions | ui/screen/** → composable rendering + intent forwarding | ui/viewmodel/** → state mgmt + intent handling + data flow | data/local/entity/** → ObjectBox entities | data/local/repository/** → local writes/queries/pending ops | data/repository/** → read-side remote fetch/caching only | data/sync/** → pending op execution/retries/remote write sync | data/di/** → Hilt bindings/providers (incl handler maps)

placement-decision-rules.rule: ViewModel = transform domain data → UI state. LocalRepository = mutate local storage or enqueue pending ops. SyncHandlers/SyncManager = network writes + ID remapping. Repository = GET/read concerns + cache hydration. Keep debug diagnostics/mocks in src/debug only.

screen-viewmodel-data-flow-contract.rule: Screens: render state + emit UI events only — no business/sync/persistence rules. ViewModels: own state models + event reducers; write via LocalRepositories only; no direct API invocations. Repositories: provide read models from network/cache/local pathways; mutation-free. Sync: executes queued ops, retries failures (max 3), reconciles IDs/state; exclusive network-write path.

repository-sync-structuring-rules.rule: Read concerns in repositories. Write concerns in LocalRepository + SyncHandler flows. New entity support must include: local entity + repo wiring, sync handler registration in SyncModule.kt, API mapping (toCreateRequest/toUpdateRequest), integrity/fetch coverage. Never bypass pending ops for write paths. PendingOperationEntity stores payload JSON for handlers. SyncManager listens to NetworkMonitor, retries failed ops (max 3). SyncableLocalRepository provides toCreateRequest/toUpdateRequest.

anti-patterns.rule: HARD NO: 1) Direct server writes from ViewModel or Repository. 2) Hardcoded UI values for colors/spacing/typography/shapes/timings. 3) Ad-hoc Log.* when common.logging.Logger domains available. 4) Unrelated icon libs when existing packs provide equivalents. 5) Business logic in navigation files or @Preview composables. 6) Shared production logic in variant-specific source sets.

conventions-patterns.rule: DI via Hilt modules in data/di; SyncHandler map by EntityType in SyncModule.kt; shared coroutine scope from ScopeManager. OkHttp: MockInterceptor (debug) → HttpLogging (debug) → AuthInterceptor; Retrofit base URL from BuildConfig.BASE_URL. Logging: common.logging.Logger domains (Logger.Sync, Logger.Database, Logger.App). Theming: FinsibleTheme values only. Durations: ui.constants.Duration constants. Icons: composables icon packs + route mapping via ui/util/IconResolver.kt. Navigation entry in ui/navigation/NavigationRoot.kt. Screens in ui/screen. State/events in ui/viewmodel. Component creation: 3-layer templates in ui/component/templates/; modifier first; @Preview; stateless by default. data integrity: DataFetcher.ensureDataFetched + IntegrityChecker.

delivery-checklist-new-component.rule: 1) modifier: Modifier = Modifier first param. 2) stateless API first, stateful wrapper only if necessary. 3) @Preview variants for key states (default/loading/empty/error). 4) FinsibleTheme tokens only for colors/spacing/typography/shapes/timings. 5) Duration constants for timings. 6) Existing composables icon packs + resolver mapping. 7) Flat 6-package layout: component/core/default/model/preview/util.

delivery-checklist-new-screen.rule: 1) Add routes/wiring in ui/navigation/NavigationRoot.kt. 2) Split render (ui/screen/) from orchestration (ui/viewmodel/). 3) Read data via Repository-backed flows. 4) Writes through LocalRepository paths that enqueue pending ops. 5) loading/empty/error UX states represented. 6) FinsibleTheme tokens only. 7) Duration constants for animations.

delivery-checklist-new-entity.rule: 1) Add entity + LocalRepository ops. 2) Creates use negative IDs + pending op serialization. 3) Add/update SyncHandler + bind in SyncModule.kt. 4) Implement toCreateRequest + toUpdateRequest mapping. 5) Cache routing + integrity checks/fetches. 6) ObjectBox schema: edit entity, commit objectbox-models/default.json, bump DATABASE_SCHEMA_VERSION if breaking.

quality-gate-pre-pr.rule: Pre-PR self-check: 1) architecture chain preserved. 2) source-set boundaries respected. 3) UI template/theming/duration/icon rules followed. 4) integrity/cache/sync wiring updated. 5) docs tree updated if structure changed. 6) No anti-patterns violated.

quality-gate-build-commands.rule: Focused diagnostics (IDE/static) for small/localized changes. Full checks for cross-layer: ./gradlew assembleDebug, ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest, ./gradlew installDebug (when device behavior involved).

execution-sequence.rule: 1) Classify request type + blast radius. 2) Choose owner layer (UI/VM/LocalRepo/Repo/Sync) using placement rules. 3) Implement minimal primary-file changes first, then wire dependent layers. 4) Focused diagnostics for localized edits. 5) Gradle checks only for broad/cross-layer/architecture-risky changes. 6) Re-check anti-pattern rules + update project structure tree.

exploration-pointers.rule: Sync layer: data/sync/*, data/local/repository/SyncableLocalRepository.kt, data/local/entity/PendingOperationEntity.kt. Caching: data/remote/converter/ResponseHandlingConverterFactory.kt, data/sync/CacheManager.kt, data/repository/*. UI: ui/component/templates/**, ui/theme/** Startup: FinsibleApp.kt, data/sync/PostAuthInitializer.kt, data/sync/IntegrityResolverService.kt, ui/screen/Launch.kt, ui/screen/Onboarding.kt

modifier-position.rule: Modifier follows required params, before optional params. When all params have defaults, modifier may be first.
